io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.storage.backend

Interface BlockStorageBackend

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    JdbcBackend, LegacyFileBackend

    @Beta
public interface BlockStorageBackend
    The BlockStorageBackend interface is the abstract layer on top of our block storage backends (blocks, chunks and inventories). Every backend has to implement this interface.

    This API is still experimental, it may change without notice.

      • deleteBlocks

        void deleteBlocks(@Nonnull
                  org.bukkit.World world,
                  @Nonnull
                  java.util.Collection<org.bukkit.Location> locations)
        Explicitly deletes the block rows at the given Locations. The dirty per-id Config objects passed to flushBlocks(World, Map) are delta-only (they don't carry the "full known state" the legacy .sfb file did), so a removed location is simply absent from them - indistinguishable from "not touched". This method is the explicit signal backends need to actually delete a row.
        Parameters:
        world - The World the locations belong to.
        locations - The Locations to delete.
